text: WWN is a mod for Rusted Warfare set in the Milky Way galaxy. Two playable factions clash here — the Fenearth Republic and the Proton Movement — and the events of the mod unfold against the backdrop of the Triple Conflict, which began in 2121 PZLI. The beginning Long ago there was a race of giants striving to explore their surroundings. They were called the Wanderers . They could travel between galaxies, creating gate systems in them. Their goal was to study as many galaxies and species in them as possible. One day the Wanderers stumbled upon a completely dead galaxy filled with biomass — it turned out to be a virus of bio nanites, half of which reside in the fourth dimension. The nanites can take control of any living being and turn it into biomass. Unaware of this, the Wanderers infected themselves and part of the known galaxies. After unsuccessful attempts to find an antidote, they decided to quarantine all galaxies to prevent the infection from spreading. To do this, they created a synthetic race of Keepers from the fungus like species most resistant to the nanites. The Keepers were to guard the gate systems in the quarantined galaxies and also try to find an antidote on their own. Map of the galaxy One of the quarantined galaxies was the Milky Way — recently discovered by the Wanderers and not yet fully built up with gates. This is where the entire subsequent history of WWN unfolds. Map of the galaxy in the era of the Distant Past Factions and races Fenearth Republic (FR/Fenearth) — an independent state formed during the Galactic Turmoil in 2061 PZLI. Proton Movement — a union of clans and small states on a federative basis in the Oten Territory; the main race is the Vasst (Protonians). What's next History of the Galaxy — eight eras from the Wanderers to the Triple Conflict. Fenearth Republic — the state of humans and Fenkars. Proton Movement — the union of clans of the Oten Territory. Vasst — the race of crocodile like amphibians known as Protonians.

The history of WWN spans eight eras — from the appearance of the Wanderers and the Keepers to the Triple Conflict, in which the events of the mod take place. History of the Wanderers and Keepers Long ago, there existed a race of giants striving to understand their surroundings. They were known as the Wanderers. They could travel between galaxies, creating gate systems within them. Their goal was to explore as many galaxies and species as possible. This continued until they encountered a completely dead galaxy filled with biomass. During their investigation, they discovered that it was a virus of bio nanites, half of which existed in the fourth dimension. They were able to take control of any living being and then transform it into biomass. Unaware of this, the Wanderers infected themselves and part of the known galaxies. After unsuccessful attempts to find a cure for the infection, they decided to quarantine all galaxies to prevent further spread. For this purpose, they created a synthetic race of Keepers from the fungus like race most resistant to the nanites. The Keepers were tasked with guarding the gate systems in the quarantined galaxies and attempting to find a cure on their own. Distant Past One of the quarantined galaxies was the Milky Way. This galaxy, recently discovered by the Wanderers, had not yet been fully built up with gates and had not been explored. After a long time of study, the Keepers in the galaxy discovered infections caused by mutated nanites. They then attempted to reduce their numbers and strength by eliminating all infected beings. This is how they earned universal hatred. Time passed, but the Wanderers never made contact again, and the nanites seemed to be suppressed. The Keepers began to decline and deviate from their purpose, and in the eyes of most races, they became mere mad fungi, ready to destroy them at any moment under their single pretext of "Purification." Map of the galaxy in the era of the Distant Past Period of Gii Races began to block and press the Keepers. Minel — one of the oldest and strongest empires — took upon itself the sacred duty of eradicating this Central Scourge. After more than twenty Crusades, it finally managed to defeat the Keepers and take a dominant position in the galaxy. However, the rapidly developing Olympian Empire was ready to challenge this power. Map of the galaxy in the Period of Gii Amidst the growing tension and a series of minor conflicts, Minel and the Olympian Empire created some of the most advanced fleets and armies, which ultimately saved them. Confrontation of Minel and the Olympian Empire in the Period of Gii War of Purification Unexpectedly, the isolationist state of Ren Acha attacked... the entire galaxy. They made no demands; their sole goal was "Infection"... It seemed they were not in control of themselves and were infected by something. It turned out to be mutated nanites that had lain hidden and evaded the Keepers. They had parasitized the Brute race for hundreds of years, secretly building a fleet and army. Now they were ready to conquer and infect the entire galaxy. Minel and the Olympian Empire were the first to face the attack. Setting aside their past differences, they formed a defensive alliance — the Star Confederation — which was soon joined by the Fenkar Federation, the Clans of Oten, and other states. Thus began the War of Purification. Map of the galaxy in the era of the War of Purification During the war, Minel and Olympia lost most of their territories, industries, and troops, which were gradually replaced by the technology of the Fenkar Federation. It took almost a century to defeat the Enslavers. In the end, more than half of the galaxy was destroyed, countless worlds, populations, and races were infected and subsequently Purified. The galaxy at the final stage of the War of Purification Period of Calm To cope with the widespread grief and problems, the states unanimously voted to reform the Star Confederation into the Galactic Federation. The galaxy began to recover and address internal issues collectively. Troops were conserved and reduced. Many purified and uninhabited planets were terraformed and resettled, and the standard of living began to improve. Map of the galaxy in the Period of Calm Galactic Turmoil Unfortunately, the management apparatus was imperfect, bureaucratic, and corrupt. Despite the propaganda of friendship, old grievances and national disputes tipped the scales. This led to the beginning of the Galactic Turmoil. Uncontrollable anarchy began to engulf the once unified state. Hundreds of fleets that had recently saved the galaxy started fighting each other. Local warlords declared themselves rulers of planets, seizing, plundering, and destroying neighboring systems and their own kind. Admirals and generals usurped power. The Galactic Federation tried desperately to reconcile the galaxy, but after 70 years of agony, it fell. During the Turmoil (1995 2077 CE), humans from Earth managed to venture into space and defeat their first enemies. Together with Fenkar, they formed the Fenearth Republic (2061 CE), which became a self sufficient state on the new political map. Map of the galaxy during the Galactic Turmoil Recent History After the end of the Turmoil, the following states emerged on the galactic scene: the Fenearth Republic, the Proton Movement, Minel, Aun, and the Black Market Territory. They all agreed to an unspoken truce to deal with the problems following the dissolution of the GF. During this time, several local conflicts and events occurred. The most significant were the secession of the Olympian Sector from Aun (which became NAun) followed by a civil war, and the creation of Minel's Incorporation of Independent Regions (essentially creating vassals from nearby small states). The Fenearth Republic (FR/Fenearth) is an independent state formed during the Galactic Turmoil in 2061 PZLI (Earth calendar). General information Fenearth is a federative parliamentary republic occupying most of the Capo Nant sector of the galaxy. Its economy is one of the strongest in the galaxy, and its powerful industrial base was inherited by the republic from the Galactic Federation. Characteristics Parameter Value Territory Occupies most of the Capo Nant sector of the galaxy ( 21% of the entire galaxy) Capital Planet Fenkar Form of government Federative parliamentary republic Highest governing body Supreme Republican Parliament Economic position One of the strongest in the galaxy (2nd place) Main currency Reformed Galvals Military power Has significant military potential Main races Lets (Fenkarians), Humans (Earthlings), Seuzians (Siauaya Awarites), Olympians Rights and opportunities All races have equal rights and opportunities History of origin The history of the Fenearth Republic goes back to the beginning of the Galactic Crisis and the start of the Galactic Turmoil. After the Ramderan Uprising and the onset of lawlessness, the industrial elite became concerned about possible dangers and proclaimed the creation of a defensive federation to protect their planets and infrastructure. Later, similar unions joined it and the Alliance of Federations was formed. Alliance of Federations This union tried to protect the legacy of the Galactic Federation, although it fought against it, since its command did not recognize any subjects. The Alliance of Federations existed until 2061 PZLI, when, together with the Free Space of Earth, after lengthy negotiations, the Fenearth Republic was formed. Goals and objectives The goal of the new state remained the same as that of its founders — peaceful settlement and coexistence while preserving the memory of the past. Industrial base Since the main industrial part was concentrated in the Capo Nant sector of the galaxy, the FR acquired a powerful industrial base and almost all the technologies of the GF, which allowed it to keep producing such equipment. The timely discovery of the Hidden Fleets and Operation Great Hijack also influenced the replenishment of the ranks of "ordinary" equipment. That is why almost all Fenearth hardware consists of GF technology and its modifications. Standard of living The standard of living in the Republic remains acceptable, although it varies depending on the planets. The Proton Movement (Unified Oten PHATHOU) is an independent sovereign state, a union of clans and small states on a federative basis, located in the Oten Territory in the Capo Bul sector of the galaxy. General information The Proton Movement occupies 22% of the galaxy. Despite having a huge number of subjects, it is an extremely unitary and centralized state where the clan and federative components are more of a formality and a tribute to history. Clans and other subjects retain only a small degree of autonomy and have great historical and cultural differences among themselves. Each clan has its own traditions and charter, and various races and their subspecies with different rights reside on its territory. Each clan has its own troops, which operate as part of the United Proton Liberation Army. The government consists of elected representatives from all subjects, with the greatest weight given to the ancestral clan Kipfus. Governance is carried out locally by clans, which in turn unquestioningly obey Kipfus and the capital on the planet Gamprellaka. The main races are Vasst (Protonians), Syndigates, Unorons, Okands. The main currency is Energy Credits. Characteristics Parameter Value Territory Oten Territory in the Capo Bul sector of the galaxy (22% of the galaxy) Capital Planet Gamprellaka Form of government Union of clans and small states on a federative basis (in practice an extremely centralized unitary state) Government Elected representatives of all subjects; the greatest weight is held by the ancestral clan Kipfus Main races Vasst (Protonians), Syndigates, Unorons, Okands Main currency Energy Credits History of origin The movement was formed during the Galactic Turmoil in 2020 PZLI by the Vasst clan Kipfus (KHEFOUS) as a national liberation movement of the Vasst and all sympathizers from the control of the hopeless, fading Galactic Federation and the looming threat from the newly formed Minel (the main historical enemy of the Oten Territory). In its region it became a mass movement and united many races, and thanks to the Gate System, Proton spread across the entire Oten Territory with incredible speed. Name Proton (PHATHOU) is a name where PHA in Unified Oten means "I" or "One", and THOU means "order"; it literally sounds like "I am order" or "First order" and symbolizes that for the first time in a long while order will reign in the Oten Territory and that everyone brings this order. However, due to a misinterpretation by Minel propaganda, which portrayed the Protonians and the Vasst, who were the main race in the movement, as evil, the name Protonians stuck to them. Protonians are very warlike and quite diverse in traditions and charters, and conflicts periodically arise within, which can escalate into skirmishes until the government intervenes. However, Protonians have always united against common enemies. Technology and armament For a long time, like the whole galaxy, the Proton Movement used the old equipment of the Galactic Federation. But at the same time, in hundreds of backyard workshops, new prototypes of the most unusual and often ridiculous weapons were built on their knees. However, they were immediately tested in battle, and the best of them entered service in the army and replaced the lost "ordinary" equipment. At the moment, Proton has developed all the necessary types of weapons and civilian equipment and has almost completely replaced everything left from the Galactic Federation. Each clan has its own production system, albeit connected with the others, and each enterprise uses its own materials and technologies. Therefore, their equipment may look different. All equipment has a simple design, which makes it very unpretentious and reliable, but fragile. This is compensated by widespread field repairs and available materials and manpower. Although the Protonians use what they consider a very "safe and cautious" tactic, they usually have more casualties than others. The Vasst (more commonly known as Protonians) are crocodile like reptilian predatory unisexual amphibious beings and the main race of the Proton Movement. General information The Vasst (more commonly known as Protonians due to a propaganda error) are a very widespread spacefaring race of crocodile like reptilian predatory unisexual amphibious beings, mostly inhabiting the Capo Bul sector of the galaxy within the Oten Territory. They are the main race of the Proton Movement. Their behavior, traditions and lifestyle are very extravagant and even repulsive to others, and their language is incredibly difficult to pronounce, as are other languages for them. Due to the fact that no population counts are kept as such, the exact number of Protonians is unknown. According to Minelian experts, Protonians are the most numerous race in the galaxy (and the most terrible threat, in their opinion). History and origin The homeworld of the Vasst is undoubtedly the planet Gamprellaka, where this race originated millions of years ago. It is one of the oldest races in the galaxy. The name Vasst was given to this species by a race of so called Luripo, who occupied the planet and intended to reconcile all the warring clans on the planet and educate them. However, the clans united and ate the Luripo (literally) and took their technologies. So this race went into space and began to occupy the cosmos. It spread to many planets, many of which have living conditions different from their homeworld. And thanks to their amazing adaptation, the Vasst changed greatly on thousands of worlds and have countless subspecies. Often this is not very noticeable, but there are also species with various serious differences. Main characteristics In appearance they most resemble Earth's crocodiles, but differ greatly from them both externally and internally. They are 2 to 5 meters long. Skin color varies from dark gray to bright green. Different shades occur. The build is always slender and lean. From 30 to 60% of the body is the tail. Four powerful agile legs, together with the flexibility and lightness of the body, provide amazing mobility and the ability to swim and pass through all sorts of obstacles and gaps. A strong body, bones and skin give the Vasst increased survivability. And strong resilient eyes allow them to see in the infrared range, which makes Protonians dangerous both day and night. Their special metabolism and special skin allow them to feel quite comfortable on different planets; nevertheless, they still need a special filter. Some subspecies have a long tongue that allows them to grasp objects and prey. Others have venomous glands. Also, claws and spine can be of different shapes — from almost absent to very sharp. On average, they can hold their breath from 5 minutes to 3 hours. Some species can breathe underwater (with limitations). Various Vasst can hibernate. Vasst are unisexual (in sexual characteristics they resemble more the male individual). Depending on the subspecies, they can be egg laying or viviparous (the Vasst of the Tkhikontou clan stand apart, as they were capable of reproducing by budding). The offspring always develop in special mud nests, but not without the supervision and help of the parents. Culture and behavior The nature of the Vasst has always been warlike, but not without honor and respect for the enemy (the exception being the Ziyongons (Minelians)). The Vasst lack fear as such, as we know it, as well as a number of other feelings. That is why they can so boldly rush into battle against gun barrels or act immorally towards other races. However, in their culture this is considered normal. It is also worth noting that they are quite honest and straightforward. In daily life and culture they are just as diverse in their traditions and habits. They are quite superstitious about their rules of behavior and omens. They live in pairs, in large communities of about 100 individuals. Each community lives in its own quarter building in large crowded settlements. The settlements are chaotically built, crooked communal house hives. The infrastructure is developed, though with peculiarities. Cleanliness is a very relative concept for Protonians, because the nature of amphibians implies a wet, dirty water environment, so their homes and equipment are a terrible nightmare for cleanliness obsessed perfectionists (the Ziyongons (Minelians)). Nevertheless, there is almost no unpleasant smell due to specific pheromones. Technology and genetics Thanks to the technologies of the Luripo race, they have long experimented with genetic engineering and, thanks to their simple genetic code, learned to create mud clones in their own image, the so called Deguers. Installing WWN takes a couple of minutes. Below are all the ways: through Steam Workshop and manually. Option 1. Steam Workshop (recommended) 1. Open the mod page on Steam Workshop. 2. Click Subscribe . 3. Launch Rusted Warfare — the mod appears in the list and updates automatically. Important: everyone in an online match must run the same mod version. Option 2. Manual install 1. Download the mod archive: Google Drive. 2. Unpack the archive. 3. Copy the files into the directory of your Rusted Warfare installation. 4. Launch the game and enable the mod in the mods menu. Where to track updates Steam — the mod updates automatically. Discord — announcements and discussion. Common problems Problem Solution The mod is missing in the menu Check the folder and restart the game Version error in an online game All players must run the same WWN version Old saves won't open Start a new game after updating the mod Found a bug? Report it in Discord with a detailed description and your mod version.

Your first WWN match can be overwhelming: two theatres, two factions and an unfamiliar economy. This guide walks you through the first fifteen minutes. Step 0. Setup 1. Install the mod from Steam Workshop or Google Drive (see the buttons on the home page). 2. Launch Rusted Warfare and enable WWN in the mods menu. 3. For your first game pick a beginner map and an easy AI. Step 1. The first minutes Build two harvesters and send them to the nearest resources. Build a power plant — no power means no shields and no factories. Send a scout around the map: knowing the map beats your first vehicle. Step 2. Defense without panic Place AA next to your mining: aircraft are the first pressure tool. Don't chase a perfect base: in WWN the first attack arrives fast. Beginner rule: if you don't know what to do — build harvesters and recon. It's almost never a mistake. Step 3. Your first army Pick one plan and stick to it: 1. Aggression: 4–6 line units → hit the nearest enemy point. 2. Defense: 2–3 defense lines → artillery → counter attack. 3. Fleet: dock → 2 cruisers → orbit control.
